components.content: Welcome! This server runs **Jellyfin** — a free media streaming platform. Here's how to get set up.

### Step 1 — Sign Up
Head to the **token channel** and grab your invite. If you haven't signed up yet, do that first — you won't be able to log in without an account.

### Step 2 — Pick an App
**iPhone / iPad** — [Moonfin](https://apps.apple.com/app/moonfin/id6741721554) *(best option)*
**Android / Android TV** — [Findroid](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.jdtech.jellyfin) or official Jellyfin app
**Windows / Mac** — [Jellyfin Media Player](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-media-player/releases) or the web browser
**Fire TV / Roku / Smart TV** — Official Jellyfin app or the TV's built-in browser

### Step 3 — Connect to the Server
When the app asks for a server address, enter:
```
https://jf.chromaah.net
```

### Step 4 — Log In
**Quick Connect** *(easiest)* — Open the app, select Quick Connect, and you'll get a code. Open Jelly Remote or the Jellyfin web dashboard, go to your profile, and enter that code.

**Username & Password** — Just type in the credentials you created when you signed up.
That's it — you're in. If something isn't working, ask in the support channel.
